listing.name: Bloodborne — bloodborne-mac (bloodborne-native)
listing.summary: This experimental native macOS project reports a three-hour new-game test on one M3 Pro, with median 42 FPS using Metal and 31 FPS using MoltenVK. Crashes, loading hangs and corruption are possible; a full playthrough is unconfirmed. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Bloodborne PS4 dump. This guide does not specify the exact accepted title and update; check the project’s source profile before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: The project describes a macOS app where you select your own game folder, then choose Play. This guide has not confirmed the source profile or package integrity. It does not establish a Rosetta or CPU-emulation route.

warnings: This experimental native macOS project reports a three-hour new-game test on one M3 Pro, with median 42 FPS using Metal and 31 FPS using MoltenVK. Crashes, loading hangs and corruption are possible; a full playthrough is unconfirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
